description: Babylove articles the daily affiliate-insert pass (Arnie) looked at and did NOT link, because no existing src/data/affiliates.json slug was a confident single-product match. Logged here so the pass doesn't re-consider the same article every day, and so Jeff or the weekly Arnie sourcing run can decide whether a new affiliates.json entry is worth adding. Adding to this file never touches affiliates.json or article content.

entries.title: Youth Sports Costs for Parents: How to Plan and Save
entries.reason: Gear nouns (bat, cleats, gloves) appear only inside a used/secondhand-equipment tip ('Borrow or buy used equipment... A $400 bat used twice is still a $400 bat'). Inserting a new-product affiliate link into advice to buy used would contradict the article's own point. No single specific product is being recommended anywhere else in the piece. Skipped, not a confident match.
